component: local development runner and independent observer

regression_before.impact: A local trace could appear to fit the 80000-token invocation cap even while carrying a conflicting value above it. The observer reused the same parser.

correction.parser: Shared strict UTF-8 JSONL decoder for Codex, Agy and OpenCode
rejected: duplicate keys at any object depth
correction.failure_behavior: The trace retains a line-numbered terminal error and cannot report terminal_success or complete. The observer recomputes usage from the recorded bytes and rejects a forged successful summary.

verification.lint_command: uv run ruff check scripts/run_development_arm.py tests/test_run_development_arm.py tests/test_observe_development_run.py
verification.independent_review: No findings in reviewed scope. Reproduced rejection of a nested duplicate key, 1e999 in metadata and invalid UTF-8 after the final event; terminal_success and complete remained false.

limits: The traces and adversarial cases in this verification are synthetic.
Local parsing does not authenticate the provider, model, effort, token usage or billing receipts.
The N/SDD/toolkit confirmatory comparison remains unexecuted.
